records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hiori? Is everything okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori? Is everything okay?
records.en: Hiori-san? Is everything okay?

records.jp: ん、ああいや、ごめん。<CR>ちょっと考え事してて……
records.en_original: Hmm? Oh, I was just thinking...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? Oh, I was just thinking...
records.en: Hmm? Oh, I was just thinking...

records.jp: ……私、最初は少しだけ納得してなかったの。<CR>本当に思い出を全部なくさないといけないのかって
records.en_original: At first, I didn't know how to feel about losing our memories. It seems unfair.
records.en_auxiliary: At first, I didn't know how to feel about losing our memories. It seems unfair.
records.en: At first, I didn't know how to feel about losing our memories. It seems unfair.

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: ……分かってる。これ以外に方法はないし、<CR>今更何を言っても仕方ないってことも
records.en_original: I know. There's no other way. Nothing I say now will change that.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. There's no other way. Nothing I say now will change that.
records.en: I know. There's no other way. Nothing I say now will change that.

records.jp: だけど……やっぱり思っちゃうんだよ。<CR>もしかしたら何か方法があったんじゃないかって
records.en_original: But I still can't shake the thought. What if there was a way...
records.en_auxiliary: But I still can't shake the thought. What if there was a way...
records.en: But I still can't shake the thought. What if there was a way...

records.jp: だって、思い出がなくなるって<CR>すごく悲しいことだよ
records.en_original: It's just too sad to lose our memories.
records.en_auxiliary: It's just too sad to lose our memories.
records.en: It's just too sad to lose our memories.

records.jp: 元の世界はもちろんだし、<CR>雫世界での思い出もたくさんあるから……
records.en_original: Not just from the old world, but all of our memories from here too...
records.en_auxiliary: Not just from the old world, but all of our memories from here too...
records.en: Not just from the old world, but all of our memories from here too...

records.jp: ……みんなとの思い出を守るために、<CR>その思い出を失わなきゃいけない
records.en_original: Unfortunately, in order to protect those memories, we have to forget them.
records.en_auxiliary: Unfortunately, in order to protect those memories, we have to forget them.
records.en: Unfortunately, in order to protect those memories, we have to forget them.

records.jp: 考えてみれば、皮肉だよね
records.en_original: It's ironic, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: It's ironic, huh?
records.en: It's ironic, huh?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: それでも……私は、前を向かなきゃいけないと思った
records.en_original: But I know I have to stay positive.
records.en_auxiliary: But I know I have to stay positive.
records.en: But I know I have to stay positive.

records.jp: だから、考え方を変えることにした！
records.en_original: So I decided to change the way I think!
records.en_auxiliary: So I decided to change the way I think!
records.en: So I decided to change the way I think!

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 全部やり直しって、裏を返せば<CR>前に失敗しちゃったことも取り戻せるってことだよね
records.en_original: Resetting everything means we get another chance at our failures.
records.en_auxiliary: Resetting everything means we get another chance at our failures.
records.en: Resetting everything means we get another chance at our failures.

records.jp: 私、もう一秒だってお姉ちゃんやお母さんと<CR>離れ離れになりたくない
records.en_original: I don't want to be away from my sister and my mother anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want to be away from my sister and my mother anymore.
records.en: I don't want to be separated from Onee-chan or Mom for even another second.

records.jp: 家族で、ずっと幸せに暮らしたい。<CR>新しい世界でなら、きっとそれもできる
records.en_original: I want us to live happily as a family together. And I thought that in the new world, we'd actually be able to do that.
records.en_auxiliary: I want us to live happily as a family together. And I thought that in the new world, we'd actually be able to do that.
records.en: I want us to live happily as a family together. And I thought that in the new world, we'd actually be able to do that.

records.jp: それだけじゃない。<CR>もっと、もっとやりたいことがある
records.en_original: But that's not all. There are so many more things I want to do.
records.en_auxiliary: But that's not all. There are so many more things I want to do.
records.en: But that's not all. There are so many more things I want to do.

records.jp: この世界で出会ったみんなと<CR>もっとたくさんの時間を過ごしたい
records.en_original: I want to spend more time with all the people I met in this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to spend more time with all the people I met in this world.
records.en: I want to spend more time with all the people I met in this world.

records.jp: ――愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao.
records.en: Ao-chan.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんももう、<CR>私の大切な人になっちゃったんだよ
records.en_original: You've become very important to me too, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You've become very important to me too, Ao.
records.en: You've become very important to me too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……<CR>
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: ありがとう。そういうふうに<CR>言ってくれる友達と出会えて……本当によかった
records.en_original: Thanks. I'm so luckily I got to meet people who care about me.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks. I'm so luckily I got to meet people who care about me.
records.en: Thanks. I'm so luckily I got to meet people who care about me.

records.jp: そうだ、今度愛央ちゃんにも、<CR>お母さんのカレー食べてほしいな
records.en_original: Ooh, you have to try my mom's curry!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, you have to try my mom's curry!
records.en: Oh, right. Next time, I want you to try Mom's curry too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 絶品なんだよ。きっと、愛央ちゃんも気に入ると思う
records.en_original: It's amazing, I know you'll love it.
records.en_auxiliary: It's amazing, I know you'll love it.
records.en: It's amazing, I know you'll love it.

records.jp: ふふっ、楽しみにしてるね
records.en_original: Hehe, I can't wait.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I can't wait.
records.en: Hehe, I can't wait.

records.jp: ……そうだ。こうやって、<CR>どんどん楽しみを増やしていこう
records.en_original: ...That's it. We just have to make new memories.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's it. We just have to make new memories.
records.en: ...That's it. We just have to make new memories.

records.jp: 新しい世界には、どんな可能性だってあるんだ――
records.en_original: Who knows what kind of possibilities there will be in the next world.
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows what kind of possibilities there will be in the next world.
records.en: Who knows what kind of possibilities there will be in the next world.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I miss you.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんに会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I miss you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 私は、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
